title: Selection bounds replacement
hook: Replacing a selection affects that selection, not every matching word.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Distinguish replacing a selected occurrence from replacing all.

objective: Distinguish replacing a selected occurrence from replacing all.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Replacing a selection affects that selection, not every matching word. Which limits the edit to the selected occurrence? Correct option: Selected replacement. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred.

claims.text: The first replacement changes only the selected position. Replace-all changes every exact match; inspect that scope before applying a broad edit.
claims.source: Derivation from the explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and transformations in src/lib/lifehacks/studyModels.ts; app documentation below provides command/filter context, not evidence of productivity gains or of every fixture-specific choice.
